reviews.text: Another company quoted me a suspiciously tiny number on the phone. Open Book gave me a real range for a night lockout and the bill landed inside it. That honesty is why I called them again for the rekey.
reviews.name: Priya N.

reviews.text: I asked about replacing all the locks in our 19th Ward house. She told me a rekey would do it for half the price because the hardware was fine. Who does that?
reviews.name: Marcus D.

reviews.text: The front door has the original mortise lock from the 1910s and nobody could find a key. He took it apart on the porch, cleaned it and cut two keys. It works like it did.
reviews.name: Helen R.

reviews.text: I manage twelve units across Greece and Gates. Every turnover gets rekeyed within a couple of days and I get a sheet listing which key goes where. Prices stay where they said.
reviews.name: Joe F.

reviews.text: Moved into an apartment near campus in late August. Rekeyed, three copies cut for roommates. The tech asked for my lease before starting, which I appreciated.
reviews.name: Sofia T.

reviews.text: Dad's safe after he passed. They asked for the paperwork first, then opened it without wrecking the door and reset the combination for us.
reviews.name: Bill K.

reviews.text: Deadbolt on the back door was wobbling. New one is solid and the strike plate has long screws now. Clear price, quick job.
reviews.name: Ana G.
